newsitem.title: USA: Standard Motor sees near-term EPS improving.
newsitem.headline: Standard Motor sees near-term EPS improving.

text.p: Standard Motor Products Inc said Monday that it is expecting "significant near term earnings improvement."

The company based its projection on improved sales it said it is experiencing in the second quarter, the favorable impact of recent acquisitions and working capital reductions that will have a positive impact on interest expense.
The company reported a first quarter loss of $0.07 a share on sales of $189 million, compared to a profit of $0.33 a share on sales of $174 million in the year-ago period.

"The first quarter's performance is not indicative of expected near term earnings. We are pursuing actions that should result in favorable year-over-year earnings performance through the remainder of 1997," a company statement said.
